overall_goal: Clean utensils, manage spilled food, and tend to the cooking vegetables

goals.description: Wash, dry, and put away the knife
goals.rationale: The person washes the knife under the tap, dries it with a towel, and stores it in the knife block.

goals.description: Clean up spilled food from the floor and wash hands
goals.rationale: The person picks up food that fell on the floor, throws it in the bin, and washes their hands.

goals.description: Stir the vegetables in the pan and cover it
goals.rationale: The person shakes the pan, stirs the vegetables with a spatula, and covers the pan with a lid.

goals.description: Return fallen onion to the pan and replace the lid
goals.rationale: The person lifts the pan lid to return a piece of fallen onion to the pan and replaces the lid.

goals.description: Empty the bowl to make room for cooked vegetables
goals.rationale: The person transfers remaining carrots from a bowl to a chopping board to free up the bowl.

goals.description: Retrieve a spoon from the drawer
goals.rationale: The person opens the cutlery drawer, takes out a spoon, and places it on the counter.

goals.description: Return fallen carrot to the pan
goals.rationale: The person lifts the pan lid to return a fallen piece of carrot to the pan.
